# Version 1.8.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### Battery

- Added battery power flow with estimated charger input, power flowing into the battery, and system power. Charger input is off by default; the other two readings are on by default.
- Added an optional CPU energy impact list showing up to five apps from recent samples. When energy counters are unavailable, it falls back to CPU activity and supports a 10–60 second sampling interval.
- On supported Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.4 or later, Charge to Full Now and Cancel Charge to Full are available and enabled by default when the capability is available.

### External Displays

- Added a BetterDisplay volume control method for external displays or audio outputs whose volume macOS cannot control directly. It supports automatic or manual display association and reports connection and error states.
- Native writable volume remains preferred, Standard/DDC mode can be restored at any time, and Status Trio does not launch or change BetterDisplay settings when BetterDisplay is unavailable.

### Stability and Interface

- Improved Wi-Fi event handling by coalescing high-frequency CoreWLAN callbacks and limiting recovery frequency during abnormal states, reducing the risk of event storms amplifying CPU and memory pressure.
- The status panel now preserves the current detail page when reopened instead of returning to the root page.
- Improved the battery details layout, detail navigation, gear hit area, and live power refresh.
- Improved menu bar composition of the colored layer and template image. Unfocused displays now dim correctly while retaining system re-tinting when switching Spaces.

### Important Notes

- Charge to Full Now uses a private PowerUI interface and is available only on Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.4 or later. There is no guarantee of behavior across macOS versions.
- After charging completes or the power adapter is reconnected, the charge limit may remain at 100%. Status Trio does not restore it automatically; use Cancel Charge to Full or restore the limit in System Settings.
- The CPU energy impact list is not total app energy usage and is not a copy of the macOS “Using Significant Energy” list.
- BetterDisplay volume control requires BetterDisplay to be running. Display volume and DDC behavior still depend on the hardware and connection.

## 中文


### 电池

- 新增电池功率流向：显示充电器输入、充入电池和系统供电的估算功率。充电器输入默认关闭，另外两项默认开启。
- 新增可选的 CPU 能耗影响列表，按最近采样值显示最多五个应用；能耗计数不可用时回退到 CPU 活跃度，支持 10–60 秒采样间隔。
- 在 Apple 芯片且运行 macOS 26.4 或更高版本的兼容设备上，支持“立即充满电”和“取消立即充满”。兼容时默认开启。

### 外接显示器

- 新增 BetterDisplay 音量控制方式：当 macOS 无法直接控制外接显示器或音频输出的音量时，可自动匹配或手动关联显示器，并显示运行及错误状态。
- 原生可写音量优先，Standard/DDC 模式仍可随时恢复；BetterDisplay 不可用时不会自动启动或修改其设置。

### 稳定性与界面

- 改进 Wi-Fi 事件处理：合并高频 CoreWLAN 回调并限制异常状态下的恢复频率，降低事件风暴放大 CPU 和内存压力的风险。
- 重新打开面板时保留当前详情页面，不再直接返回首页。
- 改善电池详情布局、详情页跳转、齿轮区域点击范围以及实时功率刷新。
- 改进菜单栏彩色图层与模板图标的合成；未聚焦显示器可正确呈现变暗效果，并保留切换空间时由系统重新着色的能力。

### 注意事项

- “立即充满电”依赖私有 PowerUI 接口，仅支持 Apple 芯片及 macOS 26.4 或更高版本，不提供跨 macOS 版本保证。
- 充电完成或拔插电源后，充电上限可能仍保持 100%；Status Trio 不会自动恢复，需要使用“取消立即充满”或在系统设置中手动恢复。
- CPU 能耗影响不是应用全部能耗，也不是 macOS“使用大量能耗”列表的副本。
- BetterDisplay 音量控制需要 BetterDisplay 正常运行；显示器音量和 DDC 行为仍取决于硬件与连接方式。

# Version 1.7.5 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### What's New

- The app icon now follows the system light and dark appearance in Finder and Launchpad on macOS 26 and later. macOS 13–15 continues to show the light icon.
- Improved Apple device battery reading by matching Bluetooth devices against names already known to macOS and pausing retries after repeated read failures, reducing unwanted pairing prompts.
- Fixed the focused row outline appearing automatically when the status panel opens with keyboard navigation enabled. Tab navigation continues to work.

## 中文


### 更新内容

- 在 macOS 26 及更高版本中，Finder 和启动台里的应用图标现在会跟随系统深浅色外观切换；macOS 13–15 继续显示浅色图标。
- 优化苹果设备电量读取：通过 macOS 已记录的设备名称筛选蓝牙设备，并在连续读取失败后暂停重试，减少无关设备和重复配对提示的干扰。
- 开启键盘导航时，状态面板打开后不再自动为首行显示焦点框；Tab 键导航保持正常。

# Version 1.7.4 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### Fixes and Stability

- Fixed the first-run guide window being too small on a fresh install, which could hide the title and bottom actions.

## 中文


### 修复与稳定性

- 修复全新安装后首次启动时，引导窗口尺寸过小、导致标题和底部按钮显示不完整的问题。

# Version 1.7.3 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### Fixes and Stability

- Improved input-source icon updates when switching input methods, including after the app becomes active or the system or display wakes.
- Fixed a possible crash when opening the first-run guide after a fresh install.

## 中文


### 修复与稳定性

- 改善切换输入法时中间连接图标的更新，并在应用重新激活、系统唤醒或显示器唤醒后重新读取当前输入源。
- 修复全新安装后首次启动时，首次使用引导窗口可能崩溃的问题。

# Version 1.7.2 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### New Features

- Input-source icon: The center connection icon can show the current input method or input source. Selecting its row opens the macOS input-source picker. You can change this in the app's Settings > Network.
- Global shortcut: Set a custom shortcut to open or close the status panel from anywhere.
- Bluetooth switch: Turn Bluetooth on or off directly from the status panel without opening System Settings.
- HUAWEI FreeBuds listening modes: Switch between Noise Cancellation, Transparency, and Off over a Bluetooth connection.
- Dock charging animation: The Dock can show its own charging animation, synchronized with the menu-bar animation.

### Experience Improvements and Fixes

- Input-source icon rendering: Fixed missing or undersized icons in the menu bar and Dock for input sources that use PDF icons, such as WeType.
- External display volume: Volume controls now match the display associated with the current default audio output, with improved DDC compatibility.
- Audio panel: Restored a compact layout and improved synchronization between the microphone volume slider and device state. Fixed missing listening-mode controls on some AirPods after their audio route becomes ready.
- Panel control alignment: Aligned buttons and controls across the battery, network, Bluetooth, and audio sections.
- Menu-bar icon guide: Improved icon location and navigation to System Settings, and fixed repeated flashing of the guide highlight.
- App activation: Fixed how the status panel and Settings window open when the app is activated through the Dock, Finder, or Spotlight.

### Performance and Stability

- Optimized charging-animation caching and scheduling to reduce CPU use during continuous playback.
- Memory used by Bluetooth monitoring, panel subscriptions, previews, and image caches is now released when the corresponding interface is closed or no longer visible.
- Improved Bluetooth permission handling, the power helper, system-command timeouts, and app lifecycle management for more stable long-running operation.

## 中文


### 新功能

- 输入法图标：中间连接图标可显示当前输入法或输入源，点击对应行可打开 macOS 输入源选择器；可在 App 设置 → 网络中修改。
- 全局快捷键：支持自定义快捷键，从任意位置打开或关闭状态面板。
- 蓝牙开关：可直接在状态面板中开启或关闭蓝牙，无需进入系统设置。
- 华为 FreeBuds 聆听模式：支持通过蓝牙连接切换降噪、通透和关闭模式。
- Dock 充电动画：Dock 可独立显示充电动画，并与菜单栏动画保持同步。

### 体验改进与修复

- 输入法图标显示：修复微信输入法等使用 PDF 图标的输入源在菜单栏和 Dock 中不显示或显示过小的问题。
- 外接显示器音量：根据当前默认音频输出匹配对应显示器，改善 DDC 通信兼容性。
- 音频面板：恢复紧凑布局，改善麦克风音量滑块与设备状态同步；修复部分 AirPods 音频路由就绪后仍不显示聆听模式控件的问题。
- 面板控件对齐：统一电池、网络、蓝牙和音频等区域的按钮与控件布局。
- 菜单栏定位引导：改善图标定位和系统设置跳转，修复引导高亮反复闪烁的问题。
- 应用唤起行为：修复通过 Dock、Finder 或 Spotlight 唤起应用时，状态面板与设置窗口的打开行为。

### 性能与稳定性

- 优化充电动画的缓存与调度，降低持续播放时的 CPU 占用。
- 在相关界面关闭或不可见后，释放蓝牙监控、面板订阅、预览和图片缓存占用的内存。
- 改善蓝牙权限处理、电源 Helper、系统命令超时和应用生命周期管理，提升长期运行的稳定性。

# Version 1.6.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### New Features

- Low Power Mode control: an optional switch in the battery details turns Low Power Mode on or off without opening System Settings. It requires a one-time approval in System Settings › General › Login Items under "Allow in the Background", and the helper it registers does nothing else, runs only while the app is using it, and exits itself when idle. The approval hint stays under the control, and the whole row opens Login Items.
- Full ring level: choose the charge level at which the battery ring counts as full (50%–100%, default 100%). Useful on a Mac whose charge limit holds the battery below 100%; "Use the charge limit" fills the slider in from the system. The menu bar and the Dock follow together.
- Local IP address: an optional Network setting that shows this Mac's private LAN address on the network row's second line, before the Wi-Fi details. Off by default.
- Internet Sharing: the Wi-Fi and wired details pages can open the Sharing pane directly, where Internet Sharing is switched on. The app opens the pane; it does not switch sharing on or off itself.

### Fixes

- Wi-Fi signal: bridge CoreWLAN's intermittent invalid readings, so a connected icon no longer dims or reads 0 bars.
- Bluetooth device icons: draw the glyph only from the class the device itself declares (`device_minorType`), so connecting or disconnecting no longer changes it. When a vendor misdeclares a device's class — a keyboard reporting itself as a mouse, for example — the icon follows that declaration, and the app no longer corrects it.
- Menu bar icon: the monochrome chrome re-tints live while a Space is being dragged.
- Icon alignment: centre SF Symbols by their measured ink instead of their layout box, so the Wi-Fi glyph no longer sits off-centre in the ring.
- Audio: removed the duplicated volume output summary row.

### Notes

- While a Space switch is being dragged, only an icon that is monochrome throughout follows the target Space; the primitives that carry a status colour (low battery, Low Power Mode, connected power, Bluetooth) settle once the switch commits.

## 中文


### 新功能

- 低电量模式控制：电池详情中新增可选开关，无需打开系统设置即可开关低电量模式。首次需要在「系统设置 › 通用 › 登录项与扩展」的“允许在后台”中批准一次；所注册的辅助程序只做这一件事，且只在应用使用期间运行，空闲后自动退出。审批提示始终显示在该控制项下方，点击整行即可打开登录项。
- 圆环满格电量：可自定义圆环视为满格的电量（50%–100%，默认 100%），适合充电上限设在 100% 以下的 Mac；点“使用充电上限”可直接从系统读取当前上限。菜单栏与程序坞同时生效。
- 内网 IP：网络设置中可选择在网络行第二行显示本机内网 IP，位于 Wi-Fi 信息之前，默认关闭。
- 互联网共享：Wi-Fi 与有线的详情页都可打开“共享”面板，在其中开启互联网共享。应用只负责打开面板，不代为开关。

### 修复

- Wi-Fi 信号：桥接 CoreWLAN 偶发的无效读数，已连接时图标不再瞬间变淡或显示 0 格。
- 蓝牙设备图标：改为只按设备自己声明的类型（`device_minorType`）绘制，连接与断开不再让图标跳变。若厂商在设备里把类型定义错了（例如把键盘声明为鼠标），图标会跟随厂商的定义显示，应用不再代为纠正。
- 菜单栏图标：拖拽切换空间时，单色部分会跟随目标空间实时重新着色。
- 图标对齐：修正 SF Symbol 按可见墨迹而非布局框居中，Wi-Fi 图标在圆环上不再偏移。
- 音频：去掉重复的音量输出摘要行。

### 说明

- 拖拽切换空间的整个过程中，只有单色图标可以完全跟随；带状态颜色（电量偏低、低电量模式、已接电源、蓝牙）的图元仍需等切换完成后才更新。

# Version 1.5.1 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### New Features

- Now supports macOS 13 and later.
- Added optional anonymous usage statistics, off by default; turn it on yourself in Settings.
- Apple device battery: read a paired Apple Watch's battery through a connected iPhone, and show trusted Apple devices as unified rows in the Bluetooth list. Adds background battery refresh with a configurable interval, and battery is read only for selected devices that are visible in the panel.
- You can now customize the Bluetooth audio icon.

### Improvements

- Improved the icon and status panel update logic.

### Fixes

- Icon rendering: restored fidelity of cached bitmaps, steady animation resizing, the charging-bolt heartbeat tint, and menu bar and Dock alignment.
- The first Bluetooth refresh no longer opens Settings unexpectedly.

### Privacy

- Explains the optional anonymous usage statistics, what a heartbeat contains, and that no third-party analytics SDK is included. See [telemetry and privacy](https://github.com/lingyired/status-trio/blob/main/docs/privacy-telemetry.md) for the full details.

## 中文


### 新功能

- 现在兼容至 macOS 13。
- 新增可选的「匿名使用情况」统计，默认关闭，需要自己开启。
- 苹果设备电量：可通过已连接的 iPhone 读取配对 Apple Watch 的电量，并把已信任的 Apple 设备显示为蓝牙列表中的统一设备行；新增后台更新电量及刷新间隔设置。电量读取仅针对面板中可见的已选设备。
- 现在允许自定义蓝牙音频图标。

### 改进

- 优化了图标和状态面板的更新逻辑。

### 修复

- 图标渲染：修复缓存位图保真、稳定动画缩放、充电闪电心跳着色以及菜单栏与程序坞的对齐。
- 首次蓝牙刷新不再意外打开设置。

### 隐私

- 说明可选的匿名使用情况统计、心跳包含的内容，以及应用未包含第三方分析 SDK。详情请见[遥测与隐私说明](https://github.com/lingyired/status-trio/blob/main/docs/privacy-telemetry.md)。

# Version 1.4.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### New Features

- The Bluetooth panel has a new "Nearby" section (off by default): turn it on to read iPhone and iPad battery levels.
- AirPods can now switch listening modes.
- External displays can now have their volume adjusted.
- The menu bar icon can use a chosen Bluetooth device's icon in place of the Wi-Fi icon.
- New "Show battery percentage in the connection position" switch.
- New "Charging bolt pulse" switch: with the charging effect on, the bolt pulses along with it.

### Improvements & Fixes

- AirPods 5 is now identified.
- Devices with multi-part battery levels, AirPods and others (left / right / case), now use a second line, so the device name is no longer squeezed by them.
- iPhone and iPad now use different icons.
- Fixed the Wi-Fi icon not being centered at larger sizes (#30).
- Fixed volume showing as unavailable on some devices (such as some BenQ displays).

### Notes

- Display volume is supported on Apple Silicon only.

## 中文

祝大家国庆节快乐


### 新功能

- 蓝牙面板新增「附近设备」分组（默认关闭）：开启后可以读取到 iPhone、iPad 电量。
- AirPods 现在支持切换聆听模式。
- 外接显示器现在可以调音量。
- 菜单栏图标可以指定用某个蓝牙设备图标替代 Wi-Fi 图标。
- 新增「在连接位置显示电量数字」开关。
- 新增「闪电心跳」开关：开启后，充电时闪电也会跟着心跳（需先开启充电动画）。

### 改进与修复

- 识别 AirPods 5。
- AirPods 等支持多组件电量的设备（左 / 右 / 充电盒）改到第二行，设备名不再被电量挤掉。
- iPhone 和 iPad 的图标区分开了。
- 修好 Wi-Fi 图标放大后不居中（#30）。
- 修好部分设备音量显示为空（如某些 BenQ 显示器）。

### 说明

- 外接显示器音量目前只在 Apple Silicon 上支持。

## First launch / 首次启动

If macOS blocks the first launch, run:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
open "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
```

如果 macOS 阻止首次启动，请运行：

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
open "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
```

# Version 1.3.3 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


### New Features

- Added audio input controls to switch the default microphone, adjust or mute input volume, and see when the microphone is in use.
- Added a VPN status item and details for the active Ethernet connection.
- Added a charging comet effect to the menu bar battery icon.

### Improvements & Fixes

- Improved Bluetooth device recognition using HID capabilities to identify keyboards, mice, trackpads, and game controllers. A confirmation is now required before disconnecting a connected device whose type remains unknown.
- Added options to hide ghost Bluetooth devices or individual devices, with a permission prompt when needed.
- Improved the sound feedback when changing the volume and reduced memory use in Dock icon previews.
- Optimized the charging animation and reduced background monitoring when the menu bar item is hidden or the popover is closed.

## 中文


### 新功能

- 新增音频输入控制，可切换默认麦克风、调节输入音量和静音，并查看麦克风使用状态。
- 新增 VPN 状态项，显示当前连接状态；有线网络状态现在会显示当前活动链路及连接信息。
- 菜单栏电池图标新增充电彗星效果。

### 改进与修复

- 改进蓝牙设备识别：结合 HID 能力识别键盘、鼠标、触控板和游戏控制器；对仍无法确定类型的已连接设备，断开前会要求确认。
- 支持隐藏无效蓝牙设备或单个设备，并在需要时提示蓝牙权限。
- 优化调节音量时的声音反馈。
- 降低程序坞图标预览的内存占用，优化充电动画性能。
- 减少菜单栏项目隐藏或弹出面板关闭时的后台监控工作。

## First launch / 首次启动

If macOS blocks the first launch, run:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
open "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
```

如果 macOS 阻止首次启动，请运行：

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
open "/Applications/Status Trio.app"
```

# Version 1.3.1 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


## Fixes and improvements

# Version 1.3.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English


## Native glass look on macOS 26
- The popover now uses macOS 26's Liquid Glass material and blends in with the system menus; settings such as Reduce Transparency still apply.
- macOS 15 through 25 keep the look they already have, and the minimum system requirement is unchanged — no one needs to update macOS to keep using Status Trio.

## Bluetooth works better
- The status panel now lists your paired devices right away: tap one to connect, tap it again to disconnect; disconnecting a keyboard or mouse asks you to confirm in the row first.
- Drag devices in Settings to reorder them; connected devices always come first.
- Bluetooth battery levels now show by default, with no switch to turn on.

## Wi-Fi switching stays in the system
- The app no longer joins networks for you: tapping a network opens the system's Wi-Fi settings, where you do the switching.
- Status Trio no longer reads or stores Wi-Fi passwords.
- A password entry saved by an earlier version may still be in your keychain, but it is no longer used.
- Seeing your networks, the signal details and the Wi-Fi switch all work as before.

## Uses less power
- Far less background work: Bluetooth no longer polls devices on a timer, Wi-Fi scanning stops when you leave the page, and the fallback refresh slowed from every 5 seconds to every 15.

## Fixes and improvements
- Clicking the menu bar icon now opens the panel while another app is full screen.

- With the system's Reduce Motion turned on, the settings interface no longer plays transition animations.

# Version 1.2.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English

## Highlights: Bluetooth audio
- The popover's Bluetooth row now reports live state: the names of connected devices, plus left/right/case battery for AirPods. Other devices show their name only.
- While audio plays over Bluetooth, the center network icon can switch to the matching device glyph (AirPods, headphones, speakers, and so on) and render in blue, with the volume dots or arc turning blue too, so the active output is obvious at a glance.
- New Settings > Bluetooth page: switches for replacing the network icon, using blue for Bluetooth volume, letting network errors take priority, and showing Bluetooth battery levels, plus a 100%-180% Bluetooth icon size.
- Fixed a device renamed in System Settings still showing its old name.
- Fixed Bluetooth battery levels staying at Unavailable after switching between the summary and the device page.

## Battery details
- Tapping the battery row in the popover opens a dedicated page with adapter rating, time remaining, Low Power Mode, voltage, current, sample time, and cycle count.
- New net battery power estimate: charging is labeled green as Charging (estimate), and discharging reads Discharging (estimate).
- These values are best-effort estimates, not total Mac power consumption. After a power-source change macOS can take up to a minute to report new values; that window shows Sampling instead of Unavailable.

## Wi-Fi summary
- When Wi-Fi is connected, the popover uses the network name (SSID) as its title and shows the current band and signal strength below it, for example 5 GHz / -52 dBm.
- Missing measurements are omitted rather than shown as 0; Ethernet, offline, and other non-Wi-Fi paths do not show them.

## Meet your icon
- A fresh installation opens the Meet your icon guide on first launch. Select the battery arc, the center network glyph, or the volume indicator to read what each one means; the volume explanation follows your current dots or arc setting.
- The guide includes a gallery of common state combinations: charging, low battery, Ethernet, no Internet and muted, hotspot with Low Power Mode, weak Wi-Fi at 25% volume, Wi-Fi off, Bluetooth headphones, AirPods, and Wi-Fi with blue volume.
- Updating to this version, restarting, and existing installations do not open it automatically. Reopen it any time from Settings, App Icon, Open Guide.

## Volume
- New Natural Scrolling switch: when on, scrolling up with a mouse or trackpad increases the volume regardless of the system's natural scrolling preference; when off, volume follows the system's scrolling direction.
- New Adjustment Area choice: scroll anywhere in the panel, or only on the volume control.
- If scrolling up still lowers the volume with this on, a scroll utility such as MOS, Scroll Reverser, or LinearMouse is reversing the events; add Status Trio to that app's exception or ignore list.

## Settings and appearance
- Volume style (dots or arc), icon placement, and ring stroke width are now visual card pickers: the selection is marked with a concentric ring and previews the result inline.
- New Ring Stroke Width setting: Light, Regular, or Bold, applied to the battery outer ring, the volume arc, and the volume dots for a sharper result on Retina displays.
- Choosing Menu Bar only now warns that the Dock icon disappears when the Settings window closes.
- The popover's audio controls and footer are more compact: the mute toggle moves into the header, duplicate speaker icons are removed, the output device name becomes a subtitle, and a More actions entry is added.
- Popover rows now share one icon size and spacing; the default menu bar icon is 24 pt and the Wi-Fi symbol scale defaults to 160%.

## Fixes
- Changing an icon option now redraws the menu bar and Dock icons immediately instead of one step later.
- The menu bar preview in Settings stays pinned to the top of the page instead of scrolling with the options.
- Clicking a known Wi-Fi network opens the system Wi-Fi settings directly.
- The Wi-Fi symbol is centered in the status icon (issue #30).

# Version 1.1.0 （English + 中文， 中文在下方）

## English

## Highlights: Dock icon support

- The live status icon can now stay in the menu bar, in the Dock, or in both at once.
- The Dock icon renders battery, network, and volume live, with its own background style (Follow System, Dark, Light); Follow System reads Icon & Widget Style in System Settings › Appearance (macOS 15 or later).
- The Dock popover anchors to the Dock edge, so it opens correctly with a left, bottom, or right Dock, and the Dock icon now has a context menu.
- While the app is in regular mode it provides a full app menu (About, Hide, Window) instead of a menu-bar-only shell.

## Other changes

- Rebuild the settings window as a multi-column layout with App Icon, Battery, Network, Audio, Status Panel, General, and About panes, and enlarge the click targets of settings rows.
- Add Status Panel settings to choose which items the popup shows (Battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Volume) and drag them into order.
- Add a Wi-Fi panel in the popup: scan nearby networks, join a network with a Keychain-stored password, toggle Wi-Fi, and read full link details (SSID, BSSID, band, channel, width, RSSI, noise, SNR, PHY, rate, security, IPv4/IPv6, router, DNS).
- Add a Bluetooth panel listing paired devices and their connection state. It is off by default: enable it in Settings › Status Panel, and the first use asks for Bluetooth permission.
- Show the symbol the system uses for each audio output device (AirPods, HomePod, Beats, displays, and so on), draw the machine glyph for built-in output, and support driver-supplied device icons (issue #12).
- Draw a plug icon, slightly larger than the bolt, when connected to power without charging, with an option to show the percentage instead.
- Adopt the native SF Symbol for Wi-Fi, and add an icon scale slider plus a continuous volume arc option.
- Move Wi-Fi status reads off the main actor and coalesce refreshes, so opening the popup no longer waits on slow CoreWLAN calls (issues #16, #19).
- Restore the foreground color for inactive Wi-Fi states, keep the Dock body behind custom Wi-Fi cutouts, and sync icon options with Dock rendering (issue #13).
- Keep the popover Wi-Fi row blank until the fresh network name arrives.
- Thanks to @ReffWu, @hhh2210, @404404, and @SherlockGougou for their code contributions.
